title: All-hands housekeeping notes
raw_text:
All-hands housekeeping notes — 26 August 2026
Taken by Dana (Customer Success) because nobody else volunteered.

Parking
- The landlord is resurfacing the north car park from 7 September. It will be closed for roughly three weeks, possibly four, "weather dependent", which in September means four.
- Twenty-two spaces move to the overflow lot behind the loading bay. Twenty-two, not twenty-six, because four are being kept for the contractors' van.
- Permits must be displayed on the dashboard of the vehicle, face up, or Facilities will issue a warning notice. Two warnings and the permit is withdrawn for a month.
- Marcus asked whether the electric charge points move too. They do not. They stay where they are and they stay unusable for three weeks. Several people had feelings about this.
- Cycle racks are unaffected. Wei pointed out that this is the third year running that the answer to a parking problem has been "have you considered cycling".

Holiday calendar
- The Christmas shutdown is confirmed: 24 December to 2 January inclusive. These days come out of your allowance; this is not new, but it is asked every year.
- Carry-over is capped at five days and must be used by 31 March. Anything above five is lost. HR were firm about this.
- The August bank holiday swap that was trialled this year is not being repeated.
- Two people are still sitting on more than fifteen days. HR will contact you individually, which is HR for "we know who you are".

Coffee machine
- The machine on the second floor is being replaced, not repaired. The engineer's report used the phrase "beyond economic repair" about a machine that is four years old.
- The replacement arrives the week of 14 September. Until then the ground floor machine is the only one, and there was some discussion about whether that constitutes a crisis.
- It must be descaled weekly and the rota is on the fridge. Tom has been on the rota for six weeks and the fridge suggests he has not noticed.
- Decaf is being discontinued. One person objected, strongly, and by name.
- The biscuit budget is unchanged. Priya asked what the biscuit budget is. Nobody knows what the biscuit budget is.

AOB
- Fire drill Thursday, 11:00. It is a drill. Please do not take a laptop.
- The office plant has died again.
